text: And here we are, finally, home.
It’s still like that.
This is the quietest place on Earth.
You will see for yourself.
It’s so beautiful. There’s no one here.
We are here.
Three men cannot be assembled in one day.
Why can’t we? Of course, we can.
Strangely, the flowers have no scent.
Don’t you feel it?
It smells like a swamp.
No, this is a river.

Here there were flower beds, here there were flower beds,  
But the porcupine trampled them.
But their fragrance lingered for many years.
Why did he destroy them?
I don't know.
I asked him why.
He said: “One day you will understand.”
I think he just started to hate the zone.
Is “Porcupine” his real name?
No, a nickname. Like yours.

For many years, he led people into the Zone,  
and no one could stop him.
He was my teacher.
He opened my eyes.

Then they did not call him a porcupine,
but a teacher.

Then something happened to him.  
Something broke inside him.
I think he was punished.

Help me. Tie the strips of the bandage
to these metal nuts.
I’ll just take a walk.
I need ...
Be careful when you come here.
Where did he go?
Perhaps he just wants to be alone.

Why? Even with three of us here,  
I feel awkward.

He returned to the zone.  
Remember, he is a stalker.
What of this?
You see, persecution is a kind of calling.

- I imagined how stalkers differ.
- How is that?

Like a stroller  
or Chingachgook or a big snake.

**Biography of our stalker**  
more terrible.

He was in prison several times,
And he was injured here.

His daughter is a mutant,  
a so-called victim of the Zone.
They say that she has no legs.
What did he mean by “porcupine”?
What did he mean, that he was punished?
What is this, a figure of speech?
One beautiful day,
The porcupine returned from this place
and suddenly became rich.
Incredibly rich.
Do you call this punishment?
Within a week, he hanged himself.

- Why?
- Quiet!
What is this?
